profile_text.body:
Grain is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2018 that offers an AI-powered meeting recording and conversation intelligence platform. The company describes itself as built for growing teams, with a particular focus on small to mid-market and enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams. Its platform records video calls, Slack huddles, and in-person meetings, capturing video, desktop audio, transcripts, and notes, then produces summaries, account insights, and coaching suggestions. Grain states that neither it nor its subprocessors use customer data for model training, and it supports transcription and AI notes in over 130 languages.

The core product, also called Grain, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and includes meeting recording, highlight clips, CRM integration, and consent and sharing features. The platform is designed to feed meeting data into external AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT. Grain offers a free plan with unlimited recordings, basic AI notes, and a collaborative workspace, subject to a 45-minute meeting limit and 90-day history retention. Paid plans start at $15 per month per user and add advanced AI features, conversational intelligence, unlimited meeting length, and unlimited history.

The site's held facts note 181 California law exposure entries associated with the company, though no specific litigation cases are recorded.
